verdict.rationale: incident.io documents an official remote MCP server. It lets any MCP-capable AI assistant query incidents, analyze alerts, check who's on call and manage escalations, which amounts to natural-language operation through the user's AI tools. A changelog entry also says the status page can now be updated 'using the agent', pointing to a native agent that takes commands. Natural-language control is shown for only a subset of operations, and the native agent is evidenced by a single thin mention. Missing for 10: native in-product natural-language command interface documented beyond one changelog line, NL coverage of core actions like declaring or updating incidents, independent or hands-on corroboration.
